_rarities: weight = rarity weights of plain monster drops (the `monster` drop table below); every source has its own table
_dropTables: loot package (src/sim/drops.ts): rarity weights [Normal, Magic, Rare, Unique] per loot source. Item counts stay with the source (drops below, feel.json, meta.json, rift.json). Magic find (rarity boost b) multiplies Magic and Rare by 1+b and Unique by 1 + b x uniqueBoostShare.
_classLoot: weapon bases of new drops always fit the hero's class (classes.json weaponBases). Uniques with cls only drop for that class; offClassUnique = chance that a class unique of another class may still be picked (0 = never).
_uniqueRoll: unique stats roll at the best affix tier their item level allows, times uniqueRoll (so deeper copies and better rolls exist; crafted rares can beat them). lvl = lowest item level a unique drops at, weight = how often it is picked (build-defining ones rarer), cls = class-only effect, bases = base per class for class-neutral weapons, skillFx = effect values (gem/modifier keys) added to skills with all of the tags.

bell.name: The Tolling Bell

emberheart.name: Ember Heart

lamplighter.name: Veil of the Lamplighter

ashfang.name: Ashfang

rimegrave.name: The Rimegrave Blade

skyrender.name: Skyrender

unburied.name: Mantle of the Unburied

stair.name: Seal of the Endless Stair
stair.effect: Each kill grants +3% cast speed for 8 seconds (up to 10 times) and restores 2% of your maximum barrier.

_drops: monster kills. itemChance = chance of one item from a normal monster; champions, elites and area bosses drop `count` items of at least minRarity. Rarity from dropTables (by rank). Rift guardians and the pinnacle boss only drop their own burst (rift.json).
